info.cls_ename: MONASH-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Information Technology

description.describe_ch:
This course is designed to help students compose great essays. By focusing on various styles of writing, we offer a wide range of support to improve your skills in a multitude of genres, including discursive, analytical, and narrative works, which are essential to all academics and professionals. 

Through the proper use of these skills, students will be able to organize and write very cohesively, paying particular attention to the following five criteria:  thesis/focus, organization, content/development, syntax/diction, and mechanics/grammar.  

Throughout the course, students must write at least three essays, each of which the instructor shall grade with both written comments and verbal feedback.

The design of this course shall enhance your writing capability to a standard that should match all college students at home and abroad. The core skills gained herein will solidify your future progress both in academia and in other professions.

weeklyScds.tpd_learn: Midterm #2: Speech (and summaries of three classmates' speeches)

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en: In-class work/Class Participation....20% Other Assignments....20% Mid-term assignments (2)....30% (15% each) Final....30%
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Students are expected to arrive to class on time.
Students are encouraged to bring a laptop computer or tablet with which to do in-class assignments. 
Assignments must be turned in on time. The teacher reserves the right to not accept any late assignments. 
Two absences or less will not affect student grades. Students are responsible for communication and arrangements for additional absences.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
Students are expected to show up on time and ready to work. Students are strongly encouraged to bring a laptop to class, though a tablet with keyboard will work in a pinch.  Assignments will be accepted late at a penalty of 20%. Assignments will not be accepted more than two weeks after the original due date except in the case of truly extenuating circumstances.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
LLMs can be an excellent tool to aid you in your journey as a writer. At present, they cannot replace humans, and misuse or overuse of this tool will only be denying yourself a learning opportunity.
Plagiarism is unacceptable. Learning to cite properly is one of the primary goals of this course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: Students are expected to complete their work on time and by themselves. Appropriate use of outside learning aids (Grammarly, ChatGPT, other LLMs) is acceptable under circumstances outlined in class. Assignments found to be plagiarized will result in a 0. To avoid plagiarism, follow the APA citation guidelines as taught during this course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Students are expected to complete all of their own work and provide citations as needed (no restriction on formatting). Violations of academic integrity will be judged on a case-by-case basis. A first violation will generally result in a 0 on the assignment, a second violation with a harsher penalty, and a third violation will generally result in a 0 in the course.
